note: Plan piece S5. The calendar is real on both apps (ProviderCalendarView on iOS). Drawn screen, invented entries. Facts checked 2026-09-24: iOS live on the App Store (Afghanistan storefront only, since 2026-09-21, app-store/metadata.md) and Android on Google Play (since 2026-08-28) — the generator prints both store names in the footer; safebeauty.web.app/get stays the one printed link and sends each phone to its own store. Salons are in Kabul only — no second city, no count. No promotion running. Every salon, name, price and time on a screen is the invented demo world from marketing/demo/ — nothing real.

fa.headline: تقویم امروزتان، در جیب‌تان
fa.body: رزروهای امروز را روی موبایل‌تان ببینید — آیفون یا اندروید.

ps.headline: ستاسو د نن تقویم، ستاسو په جیب کې
ps.body: د نن بکینګونه په خپل موبایل کې وګورئ — آیفون یا اندروید.
